verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an Auditor API that lets audit firms conduct audits in Vanta. Auditors can list assigned audits, pull controls and evidence scoped to each engagement, and manage information requests (IRLs), and marketing says Vanta helps you collaborate seamlessly with auditors. However, the evidence does not explicitly describe an in-platform, permission-scoped auditor UI that replaces emailed PDFs, so coverage of the story as written is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a scoped auditor login or view in the Vanta UI, details of auditor access controls and permission scoping, evidence of in-platform auditor commenting or request workflows replacing email, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
